name: content_hash
description: SHA-256 of the source PDF; joins to announcements.content_hash.

name: parser_version
description: Versioned parser identifier, e.g. pdfplumber_v1. (content_hash, parser_version) is unique; new parser versions append, never overwrite.

name: empty_page_count
description: Pages yielding under ~20 chars - blank or scanned (image-only) pages.

name: quality
description: good = all pages have text; partial = some empty pages; empty = no text at all (OCR queue). Text itself lives in GCS at parsed/{parser_version}/{content_hash}.json.
